name: Scrapbook UI
summary: Cut-out photos, tape, stickers, torn paper, handwritten notes and slight tilts on a paper ground. It makes a page feel like a handmade album and a personal object.

philosophy.core_thesis: The page is a handmade album: warm, imperfect and made by a person.
design_principles: Tilt each card, photo and sticker by -4° to +4° and never place two neighbours at the same angle.
Put a strip of tape (80px by 24px, yellow or white at 70% opacity, rotated 5° to 15°) on the top corner of photos.
Add torn paper edges with an SVG mask of 6px to 12px amplitude on 2 sides of each paper block.
Use a paper ground (#F4ECD8) with a grain of 4% to 8% and 3 to 5 flat accent colours at 70% to 100% saturation.
Set notes in a handwriting face at 20px to 28px and body text in a plain sans at 16px.
Cast a soft shadow of 0 4px 8px at 18% under each paper item and rotate stickers with a 3px white outline.
Overlap items by 8px to 24px and layer at least 3 depth levels (paper, photo, sticker).
anti_patterns: Hard digital edges with no texture
Stock photos with no crop or frame
Fixed icon sets in a straight row

layout.grid_mechanics: A loose collage on a 6-column base; items overlap by 8px to 24px and tilt by -4° to +4°; one anchor block holds the headline.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 5% to 15% of the surface is empty; gaps are uneven (12px to 48px).
layout.alignment_rules: Mixed: flush left text blocks, centred stickers, notes at random corners; right edge is ragged.
layout.container_geometry: Paper rectangles with torn or deckled edges; polaroid frames with 12px side and 40px bottom margins; stickers with a 3px white outline.

font_pairings.note: A natural handwriting for notes and labels.
A rounder, child-like hand for stickers.
A typewriter face for captions on tape.

typography.tracking: Hand faces take 0; sans body takes 0.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: regular (400) and bold (700).
Set notes in the hand face and body in the sans.
Set date stamps in a typewriter face at 12px.

color.contrast_rules: Ink on paper holds 12:1; white text only on tomato and teal at 18px and larger.
color.surface_treatment: Flat paper fields with a grain of 4% to 8%; no gradient.
color.light_and_shadow: Light is soft and from the top: a shadow of 0 4px 8px at 18% under paper items.

materiality.surface_simulation: Paper, tape, photo prints and craft stickers.
materiality.border_rules: Torn and deckled edges; a 3px white outline on stickers.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Shadow 0 4px 8px at 18%; two layers of overlap shadow; no blur on content.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Hand-drawn icons with 2.5px strokes and round caps; stars, arrows and hearts as stickers.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Cut-out photos, tape strips, stamps, doodles and torn paper.

motion.transition_physics: Light and playful: items drop in with a 4° wobble in 400ms; stickers peel up on hover.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover lifts an item 4px and straightens its tilt to 0°; active state presses it back to scale 0.98.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels warmth, nostalgia and the presence of the maker.

avoid_when: The product needs dense data tables.
The brand must look precise or corporate.
The page needs fast, quiet scanning.

modifiers.how: Straighten items to 0°, remove tape and keep the paper ground and one hand font.
Use photocopy black and white, cut letters and a 2px offset.
Swap paper for soft 3D blobs and 24px radius.

pack.why: A hand-drawn, sticker-like family with a thick round line.

tailwind.classes: rounded-sm bg-[#C8401C] px-5 py-3 font-bold text-white shadow-[0_4px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.18)] -rotate-1 transition-transform duration-[400ms] hover:-translate-y-1 hover:rotate-0
